anamnez.title: Intake (Anamnesis)
anamnez.subtitle: Dated assessment records with history. The client profile is independent of these records.
anamnez.wellnessNote: This form is not intended for medical diagnosis or treatment; it supports the consultation process.

consent.missing: There is no explicit consent record for special category (health) data for this client. Using the intake is not blocked; completing the KVKK consent record is recommended.

source.changedList: Client's current information differs from this intake

list.filledFormSaveFirst: Save first: unsaved changes are not included in the PDF.
list.empty: There is no intake for this client yet.
list.emptyHint: The first intake starts from the standard form; you can add or remove questions for this client.
list.draftHint: A client can have only one draft at a time.
list.error: Intake records could not be loaded.

create.title: New intake
create.modeLabel: How would you like to start?
create.modeStandard: Start from the standard blank intake form
create.modeStandardHint: All questions of the standard template start empty.
create.modePreviousHint: The answers and client-specific form layout of the selected intake are COPIED into the new record. The previous record does not change; the two records are not linked.
create.draftExists: There is already an open draft for this client. Complete or delete the draft first.

editor.notFound: Intake not found or you do not have access.
editor.lockedTitle: This intake is completed and locked.
editor.lockedHint: Create a new intake for corrections or updates; this record is preserved as history.
editor.completeMessage: A completed intake is locked and can no longer be edited. Later changes are made with a new intake record.
editor.conflict: This intake was updated in another session. Note your changes before reloading the page.
editor.resetMessage: Client-specific hiding and title edits are removed. No saved answer is deleted; answered custom questions are kept hidden.
editor.healthNoteHint: Read-only reference. The content is not transferred into the intake automatically; you can enter relevant information in the appropriate field yourself.
editor.leaveMessage: Unsaved changes will be lost. Do you still want to leave?

section.optionalOff: This section is off by default for data minimisation; use it only when applicable.
section.enable: Use this section for this client
section.disabledNote: Section is off. Saved answers are kept.
section.addField: + Add a question for this client
section.noVisible: All questions in this section were removed for this client.

custom.addTitle: Add a question for this client
custom.label: Question
custom.scopeNote: This change affects only this intake; the standard template and other clients do not change.
custom.invalid: A question title and (for choice questions) at least 2 options are required.
custom.deleteWithAnswer: This question and its saved answer will be permanently deleted.
custom.deleteNoAnswer: This question will be permanently deleted from this intake.

hidden.title: Fields removed for this client ({count})
hidden.hint: Saved answers of removed fields are not deleted; you can add the field back.
hidden.removeTitle: Remove this field for this client?
hidden.removeWithAnswer: This field has a saved answer. The field is removed from the form but the answer is NOT deleted; you can add it back from "Removed fields".
hidden.removeNoAnswer: The field is removed only from this intake's form; the standard template and other clients are not affected.
hidden.clearMessage: The saved answer of this field will be permanently removed from the draft (when you save).

import.available: There is existing information for this section in the client details.
import.done: {count} field(s) brought in from client details. Remember to save.
import.nothing: Nothing new to bring in; fields are already up to date.

conflict.title: Different information found
conflict.intro: The intake value differs from the client details for the fields below. No value is changed silently; choose for each field.
conflict.rowsNote: Existing rows in the intake are never deleted.

changes.bannerCompleted: The client's current information differs from this intake.
changes.bannerDraft: Some client information brought into this draft has changed since.
changes.title: Changes
changes.intro: The information below changed in the client details after this intake. No date is shown; the comparison is based on values.
changes.lockedNote: This intake is locked and will not be changed.
changes.startNew: Start New Intake with Current Information

attachments.title: Documents (PDF)
attachments.hint: You can attach documents such as a scan of the form the client filled in on paper. PDF only, max 10 MB, max 5 files.
attachments.empty: No documents attached to this intake.
attachments.removeMessage: "{name}" will be permanently deleted from this intake and from storage.
attachments.limit: At most 5 documents can be added to this intake.
attachments.notPdf: Only PDF files can be uploaded.
attachments.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
attachments.invalidPdf: The file is not a valid PDF; it was not uploaded.
attachments.popupBlocked: The document could not be opened. Your browser may have blocked the pop-up.

delete.draftMessage: The draft intake dated {date} will be permanently deleted together with its answers and {files} PDF document(s).

pdf.title: Intake Form
pdf.intro: Please answer the questions that apply to you. You may leave questions you prefer not to answer blank.

errors.NOT_FOUND: Record not found or you do not have access.
errors.DEMO_READ_ONLY: Intake records cannot be saved in the demo account.
errors.NOT_READY: The intake feature is not active yet (database update pending).
errors.LOCKED: A completed intake is locked and cannot be changed.
errors.CONFLICT: This intake was updated in another session. Reload the page.
errors.DRAFT_EXISTS: There is already an open draft for this client.
errors.PREVIOUS_REQUIRED: The intake to copy from must be completed.
errors.CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Deletion confirmation could not be verified.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: At most 5 documents can be added to this intake.
errors.INVALID_TYPE: The file is not a valid PDF.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
errors.UPLOAD_MISSING: File not found; please upload again.
errors.STORAGE_FAILED: The document storage operation could not be completed; the record was not changed. Please try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
